description: Compact committed metric threshold with resolvable vendor identity and no creative or brand-asset graph.

metric.description: Performance metrics that support rate thresholds on media buys — the verification subset of the broader metric vocabulary. Each metric specifies whether its threshold is a floor (must exceed) or ceiling (must not exceed). Shared values with `available-metric.json` mirror the delivery vocabulary (`viewability` → `viewable_rate` family, `completion_rate` → same name); verification-only values (`ivt`, `brand_safety`, `attention_score`) are typically vendor-attested and do not appear in `available-metric.json` because they're not seller-reportable scalars — they flow through `vendor_metric_values` or vendor-scope `committed_metrics` entries with the matching `performance_standard.vendor` BrandRef anchoring identity.

enumDescriptions.attention_score: Attention score rate (floor — must exceed threshold). Denominator: measurable_impressions.
enumDescriptions.brand_safety: Brand-safe impression rate (floor — must exceed threshold). Denominator: total_impressions.
enumDescriptions.completion_rate: Video or audio completion rate (floor — must exceed threshold). Denominator: total_impressions.
enumDescriptions.ivt: Invalid Traffic rate (ceiling — must not exceed threshold). Denominator: total_impressions.
enumDescriptions.viewability: Viewable impression rate (floor — must exceed threshold). Requires viewability_standard. Denominator: measurable_impressions.

metric.title: Performance Standard Metric

standard.description: Viewability measurement standard applied to determine whether an impression qualifies as viewable. These are materially different thresholds and should not be compared across standards.

enumDescriptions.groupm: GroupM standard: 100% of pixels in view for 1 continuous second (display) or 50% of video duration.
enumDescriptions.mrc: MRC/IAB standard: 50% of pixels in view for 1 continuous second (display) or 2 continuous seconds (video).

standard.title: Viewability Standard

vendor.description: Stable brand identity used to resolve the canonical brand manifest, optionally qualified by the countries of a commercial advertiser entity. The manifest URL is derived from domain; callers do not send brand assets or per-call brand overrides. Countries do not target delivery.

brand_id.description: Brand within a house-of-brands manifest. Omit for a single-brand domain.
brand_id.title: Brand ID

countries.description: Canonical set of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries for this advertiser identity. Omit when the identity is global or the house does not split the brand geographically. Array order is not meaningful; producers MUST sort codes lexicographically before computing keys or signatures. This qualifies account and proposal identity and is not delivery targeting.

domain.description: Domain that hosts /.well-known/brand.json or is registered for the brand.

vendor.title: Brand Key

title: Canonical Performance Standard
